name: print-social-technology-professional-development-posts-cream-black-line-icons
title: 'Technology For Your Professional Development' pack alternating cream and black with simple line icons
whatItIs: Nine square posts alternating cream and black, each with a simple black-outline icon (envelope, stacked cards, folder, desktop computer), the recurring headline 'Technology For Your Professional Development', a small browser-window frame device on the cover, and a cursor icon accent.
whatItMeans: Calm and professional; alternating light and dark posts with one consistent icon style keeps a repetitive message visually interesting.
techniques: Alternate background colour while repeating the same message.
Use a single consistent icon style across an entire set.
Frame the lead post in a small browser-window device.

vocabulary.definition: An icon drawn using only outline strokes.
A small UI device showing content as if inside a browser tab.
